pages.text: A multiblock generator that turns liquid fuel into enormous amounts of Chi Energy.$(br2)$(bold)Building:$() surround a closed box of side length 5 or 7 with Reactor Shells (1-block thick walls, all six faces complete), placing the Controller, Fuel Port, Energy Output and Waste Port on the walls; the interior may only hold Fuel Rods, Coolers and exactly one Reactor Core.$(br2)Up to 10 fuel rods (each unlocks one fuel slot) and 20 coolers. The controller forms once the structure is complete.

$(bold)Operation:$() put Fuel Cells with liquid fuel into the controller's fuel slots to start burning. Output peaks at 400-700℃; above 850℃ it enters an overheat warning with reduced output (no shutdown). At 1000℃ full heat it WILL explode after 10 seconds - destroying the reactor and spawning a 5-chunk decay zone. Breaking the reactor or dismantling its structure at full heat leaks a decay zone too.$(br2)$(bold)Waste:$() every 1 mb of fuel produces 3 mb of Exhausted Life Fuel, stored in the built-in 64,000 mb tank - full tank halts all slots. The Waste Port only exports (pipe it out); route it to an Exhausted Barrel (1,000,000 mb) for long-term storage.
